# Hari Sawkar, MD — Urology, Tustin, California

> Board-certified urologist and Chief of Urology at Providence St. Joseph Hospital in Orange, California. Private practice office in Tustin, serving Orange County. Focus on minimally invasive treatment of the enlarged prostate (BPH), kidney stones, and urologic cancers.

## Office

- Address: 18302 Irvine Blvd, Suite 200, Tustin, CA 92780 (since October 1, 2026)
- The former office at 720 N Tustin Ave, Suite 104, Santa Ana, CA 92705 is closed.
- Phone: (714) 919-8143, answered Monday to Friday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM
- Fax: (949) 687-1217
- Secure messaging (preferred): through Klara on https://www.drsawkar.com/contact.html; the new patient coordinator replies by text
- New patients welcome. Same-day and next-day appointments for urgent concerns. Telehealth video visits for new and established patients.
- Free parking on site.
- NPI: 1063855625

## Areas served

Orange County, California, including Tustin, Santa Ana, Orange, Irvine, Anaheim, Newport Beach, Huntington Beach, Costa Mesa, and Fullerton.

## Credentials

- Board certified, American Board of Urology; AUA member
- Chief of Urology, Providence St. Joseph Hospital, Orange
- MD, Northwestern University Feinberg School of Medicine (2013)
- Urology residency, University of Southern California / LA General Medical Center (2013 to 2018)
- BS in Biomedical Engineering, George Washington University, magna cum laude

## Procedures and volume

- Aquablation: more than 250 procedures, the highest volume of any surgeon in Orange County
- Urologist-led prostate artery embolization (PAE): about 16 procedures a month. Dr. Sawkar evaluates every patient, decides whether PAE is right, and manages all pre- and post-procedure care; an interventional radiologist performs the embolization in the practice's own outpatient lab.
- Also: UroLift, Rezūm, da Vinci robotic surgery, kidney stone treatment, prostate and kidney cancer surgery, no-scalpel vasectomy, penile implants, Peyronie's disease, men's health (ED and low testosterone)
